seednet_fields.Parentage: The purpose of variety  has been develop
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Adopted to whole jute growing bell of
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: The results showed that the entry BCCC-2 recorded highest yield 29.81q/ha which was not statistically significant with the checks. BCCC-2 showed responsiveness to higher doses of fertilizer and best effect was at 100:21.8:41.7 N:P:K, kg/ha where the highest fibre yield of 31.15q/ha was observed under highest fertilizer dose F3. Although considering all the variety and fertilizer dose interaction was NS.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: The proposed variety is adaoted to rainfed situation and comparatively tolerant to biotic stresses like stem rot disease and insect pests like semilooper, BHC and Apion.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: The results revealed that the said variety showed moderately resistance (2.34-4.84%) against stem rot. The result revealted that the proposed variety BCCC-2 showed resistance against stem rot (0.96%).
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: The results revealted that the proposed variety BCCC-2 showed less infestation of apion (4.79-6.15%), semilooper (6.79-41.32%) and BHC (1.47%) as compared to the check variety. The results revealed that the proposed variety BCCC-2 showed less infestation of stem weevil, semilooper, BHC as compared to selected other entires and check variety.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): 80:40:40 N, P2O5 and K2O per ha applied as ½ N+full P2O5 and K2O as basal, 1/4N at 35-40DAS and ¼ N at 65-70 DAS

seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: THE PROPOSED VARIETY, RRPS-27-C SHOWS BETTER PEST RESISTANCE THAN BOTH THE CHECKS AND DISEASE RESISTANCE THAN JRC- 698.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: I. TOLERANT TO STEM ROT. LOWER INCIDENCE AS COMPARED TO JRC- 698 BUT HAVING HIGHER INCIDENCE TAS COMPARED TO JRC- 321. II. TOLERANT TO ROOT ROT. seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: 1. TOLERANT TO YELLOW MITE. LOWER INCIDENCE AS COMPARED TO JRC- 698. 2. TOLERANT TO SEMILOOPER. LOWER INCIDENCE AS COMPARED TO JRC- 321 AND JRC-698. 3. TOLERANT TO STEM WEEVIL. LOWER INCIDENCE AS COMPARED TO JRC - 321 AND JRC-698.

seednet_fields.Agronomic Features:
1.	Medium maturity duration, tall stature, profuse tillering, non-lodging and non-shattering variety,
2.	Responsive to irrigation as well as recommended NPK application.
3.	Suitable foir rainfed kharif as well as late kharif irrigated crop.
4.	Suitable for sole as well as inter cropping.
5.	Seed rate @ 10-12 kg/ha for line sowing.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Medium duration, Tall stature, Non-lodging with high tillering ability, Semi-compact panicle with bold brown cultured grains
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Moderately resistance to shoot fly damage (10.7% and 15.5% dead-heart at 21 and 28 DASE)
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Moderately resistant to head smut (4.3%), banded blight (25.1 PDI), leaf blight (1.6 G) and brown spot (1.7 G)
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha):
40:20:10 (NPK kg/ha)
N in two splits, half as basal and second half after 4 weeks synchronized.

seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Recommended for release & cultivation in the States of Rajasthan, Gujarat, Madhya Pradesh and Chhattisgarh in Kharif conditions.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: (i) Medium maturity and high stable yield, (ii) Long ears with attractive golden orange semi flint grain colour, (iii) Responsive to fertilizer application at medium and high levels, (iv) seed rate : 20 kg/ha by set planter or traditional sowing method, (v) Sowing distance 60 cm x 25 cm
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: First leaf anthocyanin colouration of sheath - Present, Leaf attitude of blade - Curve, Stem anthocyanin colorastion of brace roots - Present, Ear time of silk emergence (50% of plants) - Late, Leaf width of blade (Leaf of upper ear) - Broad, Kernel row arrangement - Straight, Grain shape - Indented, Grain size - Large
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: First leaf anthocyanin colouration of sheath - Present, Leaf attitude of blade - Curve, Stem anthocyanin colorastion of brace roots - Present, Ear time of silk emergence (50% of plants) - Late, Leaf width of blade (Leaf of upper ear) - Broad, Kernel row arrangement - Straight, Grain shape - Indented, Grain size - Large
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Tolerant to stresses as indicated by its stable performance across.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Tolerant to Turcicum Leaf Blight, Banded Leaf and Sheath Blight, Brown Stripe Downy Mildew, Erwinia Stalk Rot, Common rust and field tolerant to stalk rot in field and controlled conditions.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Field tolerance to stalk boror Chilo partellus.

seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Apply 15 kg of N (33 kg Urea) and 8 kg P2O5 (50 kg Superphosphate) per acre at sowing and 15 kg N (33 kg Urea) 30-40 days afterwards.

csc_fields.special_traits: Plant height: 45-50 cm. Distinguishing morphological characters: Dark red coloured bulbs, stripes on bulb, oval shape, very less number of bolters and doubles in Rabi, thin neck, number of leaves ranged from 8-12, TSS 10-10.5%. Number of leaves: 8-12/plant. Polar Diameter (P): 42-45 cm. Equatorial Diameter (E): 45-50 cm. P.E.: 0.85-0.95. Neck thickness: 0.6-0.8cm. % Total soluble solids: 10-10.5. Days to harvest after transplanting: 100-105 days in Kharif, 115-120 day in Rabi. Characters different from those of the parents: Bulbs oval in shape and single centred. Maturity (range in number of days): 115-120 day after transplanting in Rabi and 100-105 days in Kharif. Maturity Group: Early in Kharif and medium in Rabi. Agronomical features: Erect Plant habit, less pseudostem length, minimum neck thickness of the bulb, uniform neck fall during Rabi, early in maturity. Quality attributes purpose for which recommended: Table/processing/export. Table quality attributes/Nutritional quality: Attractive red colour, suitable for immediate consumption. Single centered, suitable for salad, pungent. Reaction to major diseases: Field tolerance to foliar diseases. Reaction to major pests: Field tolerance to thrips. Average yield under normal condition: 250-300 qtls/ha.

csc_fields.additional_notes: Deferred in the 54th Sub-committee meeting, for want of clarification on the authorship and parentage details and the Sponsoring Authority was advised to re-submit the revised proposal along with the required information for consideration. The Sponsoring Authority re-submitted the proposal without providing the required details. The Committee noted that the sponsoring authority has not made any efforts to clarify lacuna. Committee directed to the sponsoring authority to look into the decision of the 54th Sub-committee and to clarify the position. Committee further would also like to know what intervention was made in the proposal. Decisions taken: 1. Breeders/sponsoring authority should prepare themselves to provide the information with regards to DNA Marker/Finger Printing, prime number, etc. of the variety proposed for notification from 1st January, 2011 onwards. 2. While submitting the proposal, they should provide lucid photograph of the field, individual plant, cob, rachis, grain, etc. so as to consider physical appearance the cultivar.

seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Chhattisgarh Arhar-1 was evaluated under direct seed sowing for different crop management practices at Raipur during Rabi 2016-17.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: Yellow flower, brown streak on pods Light to Dark Brown colour seeds.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: 1.	Plant anthyocyanin coloration of hypocotyls: Absent. 2.	Plant-branching pattern: Erect. 3.	Time of flowering: Kharif 125-130 days. Rabi: 95-100 days. 4.	Plant growth habit: Indeterminate. 5.	Stem colour: Green. 6.	Leaf shape: Bipinnate non serrted. 7.	Leaf:Pubescence on lower surface of the leaf: Absent. 8.	Flower: Colour of base of petal (standard): Medium. 9.	Flower:Pattern of streaks on petal (standard): Medium. 10.	Pod: Colour: Green pods brown streaks. 11.	Pod: waxiness: Absent. 12.	Pod: Surface stickiness: Present. 13.	Pod: constriction: Prominent. 14.	Pod size (cm): 5.3-6.0. 15.	Pod: No. of seeds: 3-5. 16.	Plant height: Kharif: 211.9 cm & Rabi: 86.2 cm. 17.	Seed colour pattern: Light to Dark. 18.	Seed shape: Oval. 19.	Seed: Size (100 seed weight): Kharif-9.582g (Range 8.000-10.760 g). Rabi- 9.397 g (Range 8.750-10.000 g). 20.	Dal Recovery (%): 60.4-77.43.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Moderately Resistant (MR) to wilt diseases and less incidence of Sterility Mosaic Disease (SMD) and Phytophthora stem Blight (PSB) disease.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Less infestation of Pod Borer (H. armigera) as compare to check variety.
seednet_fields.Average Yield (Kg/Ha): Average seed yield in Kharif 1800-2000 kg/ha and in Rabi 1500-1700 kg/ha. Kg/Ha
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): 20:50:20:20 kg N: P2O5: K2O: Sulphur deficit areas. Use of herbicide viz. Pendimenthalin @ 1 kg a.i. ha-1 at 3-5 days after come up irrigation/first rains after sowing.

csc_fields.special_traits: Medium duration. Medium maturity, field resistant to late blade. High dry matter. Plant height: 70-80 cm. Haulms: Medium tall, semi-erect, plant canopy, semi-compact, vigorous. Stem: Many, medium thick, predominantly green with red-brown secondary pigment randomly distributed, wings feebly developed and wavy. Leaf: Intermediate, dark grey green, smooth, glossy, rachis, green. Large and many. Leaflets: Width medium, ovate-Lanceolate, margin entire, coalescence absent, midrib green. Folioles: Many, small. Foliage colour: Green. Tubers: Size medium, long oblong, white cream, smooth, eyes shallow, normal eyebrows, flesh white, texture mealy. Sprout: Red purple with green at the apex, shape spherical, pubescence of base slight and tip closed. Dormancy: Medium. Stolen: Medium. Flowers: Light red, moderate flowering, flower stalk green, calyx green, bud red, pedicel articulation above the middle, corolla primarily light red with tip on both sides white, corolla shape stellate, anthers orange, pollen fertile, anther cone normally developed, style longer than stamen column and stigma bio-lobed. Specific gravity: 1.093. Dry matter: 22.4 per cent. Cooking quality: Good. Texture: Floury. Stem-end discolouration: None. Medium maturing with Good keeping, responsive to fertilizers. Field resistant to late blight (Phystophthora infestans).
csc_fields.additional_notes: Recommended for notification for entire country.

csc_fields.special_traits: Plant height: 80-85 cm. Haulms: Tall, erect, medium-compact, vigorous. Stem: Many, thick, not coloured at base, well developed straight wings. Leaves: open, rachis green. Leaflets: Oval, rough surface with entire margin, Large and many. Folioles: Dark green. Tubers: Oval, Pale yellow, medium sized, fleet eyes, light yellow flesh. Dormancy: Medium (10 weeks). Stolons: Medium. Flowers: White, medium in size, moderate flowering in hills, sometime scanty flowering also observed in plains. Sprouts: Cylindrical, slightly red purple and hairy. Maturity (range in number of days): 75-85 days. Maturity Group: Early under short day conditions. Agronomical features: Can be grown as early (0 to 75 days harvest) variety. Recommended as main season crop variety under normal fertilization. Quality of produce: Good keeping quality (Storage behaviour at ambient temperature). Specific gravity (at 75 days harvest): 1.06. Dry matter (at 75 days harvest): 15%. Cooking quality: Good, cooks well in 30 minutes, tastes good. Texture: Waxy. Stem-end discolouration: Absent. Reaction to major diseases: Moderate resistance to late blight and resistant to early blight. Reaction to major pests: No major pest problem for potato crop during main season. This variety is a Nutrient efficient variety. Performs well under low fertility conditions.
csc_fields.yield_performance: 25-28 tonnes per hectare under early (75 days) harvest.
csc_fields.additional_notes: Seed rate - 3.0-3.5 tonnes/ha.

(Enclosed)
Moderately resistant to Brown spot diseses incident

seednet_fields.Parentage: The proposed variety has been developed from a cross CN 1216 X CN 1131-4-4-1-4. Both the parents are pre-breeding materials developed under Shuttle Breeding programme of International Rice Research Institute (IRRI).
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: The variety may be recommended for Kharif season under rainfed low land condition.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Seed rate is 40 kg/ha (2-3 seedlings per hill)
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Disease infection was below the threshold level for the proposed variety AAU-KMJ Dhan-46 (Surma Dhan) at RARS, Karimganj, Assam during kharif 2018 and 2019. Under field screening without artificial inoculation the proposed variety showed Resistant to highly Resistant reaction in respect of False smut and Neck blast diseases, Resistant against Brown spot and Highly Resistant reaction in respect of False smut and Neck blast diseases, Resistant against Brown spot and Highly reaction against BLB
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Under field screening without artificial inoculation the proposed variety, AAU-KMJ Dhan-46 (Surma Dhan) showed White Ear Heads (WEH) to the extent of 0.6-0.8% panicles (Score-)) indicating its Highly Resistant reaction against Stem borer. Similarly, it showed neglible damage (Score-0) in respect of Leaf folder (HR) and very slight injury (Score-1) in respect to BPH and GLH indicating Highly Resistant reactions against these two pests

60:20:40 kg/ha of N:P2O5:K2O

1st topdressing: ¼ N + ¼ K2O at 30-35 DAT
2nd topdreesing: ¼ N at Panicle initiation stage

seednet_fields.Parentage: THIS CULTURE IS DERIVED FROM A CROSS RP 2151-40-1 X IR 9828-23. FEMALE PARENT RP 2151-40-1 X IR 9828-23. FEMALE PARENT RP 2151-40-1 CAME FROM A CROSS IET 4141 X CR 98-7216, WHEREAS, MALE PARENT IR 9828-23 IS A DERIVATIVE OF IR 2071-559-2-4-6 X IR 1820-52-2-4/IR 36. THE ABOVE STATED CROSS WAS ATTEMPTED IN 1987 AND WAS BULKED IN F5 GENERATION IN 1992.
seednet_fields.Resemblence to Variety: NO RELEASED VARIETY EXACTLY RESEMBLES THE PROPOSED VARIETY IN MATURITY AND PLANT TYPE FEATURES THIS STRAIN (R 738-1-64-2-2), HOWEVER, RESEMBLES WITH THE MAHAMAYA IN GRAIN TYPE (LONG BOLD).
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: IRRIGATED : THIS VARIETY HAS BEEN RECOMMENDED FOR IRRIGATED ECOLOGY OF M.P. (INCLUDING CHHAST.) AND EASTERN U.P. BY 34TH ALL INDIA ANNUAL RICE GROUP MEETING, APRIL 11-14TH,1999; RAINFED : IN M.P. INCLUDING CHHAT. STATE ON DORSA AND KANHAR SOILS.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: BEING SEMI DWARF IN STATURE DOES NOT LODGE AND ALSO DOES NOT HAVE SHATTERING PROBLEM; IT IS RESPONSIVE TO FERTILIZER AND HAS GIVEN GOOD YIELDS UP TO FERTILITY LEVEL OF N1P2O5 120, 60, 40 KG/HA, RESPECTIVELY; IT IS SUITABLE FOR NORMAL SOWN CONDITIONS WITH NORMAL AGRONOMIC PRACTICES AS RECOMMENDED FOR HIGH YIELDING VARIETIES; FOR DIRECT SEEDING (BROAD CAST BLAST SYSTEM) 100 KG/HA AND UNDER TRANSPLANTED SITUATION 50 KG/HA SEED RATE IS RECOMMENDED.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: INTERMEDIATE HEIGHT; STRONG AND STURDY CULM; LONG BOLD GRAINS; MODERATE TILLERING.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: PLANT HEIGHT: 95-115 CM;PLANT GROWTH HABIT : ERECT; NO OF TILLERS PER PLANT 5-11 ; INTERNODE LENGTH : AVG 20.3 CM (MAX 25.0 CM a& MIN. 05 CM); LEAF SHAPE SIZE ATTITUDE : LONG ERECT AND SEMI-BROAD LEAVES; FLAG LEAF ATTITUDE : ERECT; COLOUR OF LIGULE : LIGHT GREEN; COLOUR OF COLLAR : LIGHT GREEN;P COLOUR OF AURICLES : LIGHT GREEN; COLOUR OF STIGMA : WHITE; COLOUR OF APICULUS : GREEN; PANICLE EXERTION : FULLY EXERTED; DAYS TO 50% FLOWERING : 95-115; AWNED OR AWNLESS : AWNLESS
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: BACTERIAL LEAF BLIGHT AND BLAST AMONG THE DISEASES IS MAJOR PROBLEM IN CHHATTISGARH. THE PROPOSED STRAIN HAS HIGH LEVEL OF RESISTANCE TO BACTERIAL BLIGHT COMPARABLE TO AJAVA AND IS ALSO RESISTANT TO BLAST AND TOLERANT TO SHEATH BLIGHT AND BROWN SPOT.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: THE PROPOSED VARIETY HAS FIELD TOLERANCE TO GALL MIDGE AND WBPH.

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: Agricultural Research Station, Bapatla -522101, Guntur District, A.P.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Single cropped wetlands of Andhra Pradesh particularly to NSP Ayacut area and Krishna Western Delta during kharif; Irrigated lowland Suggested for wider cultivation during kharif season in place of BPT 5204 in Krishna zone
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Non-lodging, fertilizer responsive up to 200 kg N/ha, suitable for kharif season.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: Semi-dwarf, compact tillering narrow erect green foliage extra long duration (165 days) with good grain quality and brown glumed medium slender grains, with stands submergence upto 7-10 days, long dense panicle with more number of grains and no shattering of grains under normal conditions.	Non-lodging, semi-dwarf, medium green foliage, compact plant stature, moderate tillering habit, fertilizer responsive, medium slender with dirty glume colour.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Semi dwarf, non lodging, erect plant type, profuse tillering, photoinsensitive, medium green foliage, straw glume with medium slender grains.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress:
•	Tolerant to salinity (score 3). Recorded 81.52% of spikelet fertility and grain yield of 13.47 g/plant in germplasm screening trial conducted during kharif 2013 at ARS, Machilipatnam under PH 8.5 and EC: 15
•	Tolerant to flash flood conditions for about 7-10 days. This was observed during kharif 2013 and 2014 when heavy rains due to Meelam cyclone and overflow of Nallamada drain occurred at Agril. College Farm, ARS, Bapatla.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Tolerance to bacterial leaf blight	Resistance to RTV and blast.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): •	Nursery: Basal fertilization with 0.5 kg of ‘N’, 0.5 kg of ‘P’ and 0.5 kg of ‘K’ per every 100 sq.mt. is required to get robust seedlings, followed by another 0.5 kg ‘N’ at 120 days after sowing. •

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: Rice Research Station, Chinsurah, Hooghly, West Bengal in collaboration with international Rice Research institute, Philippines"
seednet_fields.Parentage:
The proposed variety has been developed from a cross between 1R4630-22-2-5-1-3 and Nona Bokra at lRRl, Philippines.
1.	One of the parents 1R4630-22-2-S-1-3 is a saline as well as submergence resistant line with low yield.
2.	Nona Bokra a well adopted cultivars at coastal saline belt of West Bengal with 113 days to 50% flowering; 163 cm plant height and having the yield range of 3000 to 3600 kg/ha up to 5 dS/m soit EC.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Coastal saline tract of West Bengal up to Soil EC 6 ds/m. Rainfed Shallow Lowland situation (Water depth 30-50 cm) of the coastal saline tract of  West Bengal.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features:
1.	Resistant to lodging and shattering.
2.	Responsive to fertilizer, best effective as 100% RDN as basal for semi deep water situation in this coastal saline belt.
3.	1st week of July is the best time for sowing for
enhancing productivity.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Erect plant type, Erect flag leaf, Medium bold grain straw colour, Awn less panicle and white karnel. Panicle exertion complete, basal leaf sheath colour green.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: The variety is screened in vitro condition through laboratory based technique against salinity at seedling stage in scored 1(resistant) for EC 4 and 3 moderate resistant) for EC and growth and tillering  nearly normal like resistant check AT401 at EC B ds/m.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Showed resistant reactions against Bacterial leaf blight under moderate disease pressure (LSl 4.5) in State Screening Nursery at RRS, Chinsurah. ln normal field condition at Gosaba and Canning no significant diseases were observed by last three years. DRR screening Nursery for Diseases.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: The variety is found to be tolerant for Yellow Stem borer in State Screening Nursery at RRS, Chinsurah. No significant pest was observed under field condition for last three years both in Kharif and boro at Gosaba and Canning
seednet_fields.Average Yield (Kg/Ha): Around 5.0 t/ha up to Soil EC 6 ds/m). Kg/Ha
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Recommended dose of N 70 kg/ha; 35 kg P2O5 and 35 kg K2O / ha.

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: ICAR - Indian Institute of Rice Research,  Hyderabad (Telangana)
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Aerobic soils of Zone III (Bihar) and Zone V (Chhattisgarh).
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Moderately resistant to lodging and grain moderately. This is also fertilizer responsive.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Medium tall with long bold grains.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Suitable for water limited aerobic conditions.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Moderately resistance to Leaf blast and Neck blast.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Resistance to gall midge and rice thrips and moderately resistance to plant hoppers.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Green manuring with daincha, which can be incorporated into soil at about 45 to 55 days after sowing (of dahicha) and it can reduce the nitrogen dose by 20-25 kg/acre.

seednet_fields.Parentage: THIS CULTURE IS DERIVED FROM A CROSS SAMRIDHI X IR 8608-298. FEMALE PARENT SAMRIDHI CAME FROM A CROSS R 68-1 X JAYA, WHEREAS, MALE PARENT IS A DERIVATIVE OF IR 2061-465-1.5 X IR 36. THE ABOVE STATED CROSS WAS ATTEMPTED IN 1981 AND WAS BULKED IN 1987.
seednet_fields.Resemblence to Variety: NO RELEASED VARIETY CLOSELY RESEMBLES THE PROPOSED VARIETY.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: RECCOMENDED FOR DIRECTLY SEEDED RAINFED UPLAND ECOSYSTEMS OF THE STATE AND M.P.; FOR CULTIVATION ON RAINFED BUNDED MATASI SOILS OF STATE; UNDER IRANSPLANTED IRRIGATED SITUATION PROVIDED TRANSPLANTING CAN BE DONE WITH 21 DAYS OLD SEEDLING.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: BEING OF DWARF STATURE, IT DOES NOT LODGE AND ALSO DOES NOT HAVE SHATTERING PROBLEM; IT IS RESPONSIVE TO FERTILIZER AND HAS GIVEN GOOD YIELDS UPTO FERTILITY LEVEL OF 80 N, 50 P2O5 AND 30 K2O KG/HA.; SUITABLE FOR SUMMER CULTIVATION; FOR DIRECT SEEDING (LINE SOWING) 80 KG/HA AND FOR TRANSPLANTING 50 KG/HA. IS RECOMMENDED IN KHARIF SEASON.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: ENTIRE PLANT GREEN; STRONG CULM; LONG SLENDER, TRANSLUCENT GRAIN WITH GOOD HEAD RICE RECOVERY AND KERNAL ELONGATION; STRAW COLOUR HUSK; NO PIGMENTATION ON ANY PLANT PARTS.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: PLANT HEIGHT : 80-100 CM; PLANT GROWTH HABIT : ERECT; NO OF TILLERS PER PLANT : 7-15; INTERNODE LENGTH (2ND) : AVG. 18.4 CM (MAX 20.5 CM & MIN. 8.8 CM); LEAF SHAPE SIZE ATTITUDE : LONG ERECT ANDC NARROW LEAVES; FLAG LEAF ATTITUDE : MODERATELY LONG ERECT; COLOUR OF LIGULE : STRAW; COLOUR OF COLLAR : STRAW; COLOUR OF AURICLES : STRAW; COLOUR OF STIGMA : LIGHT GREEN; COLOUR OF APICULUS : GREEN; PANICLE EXERTION : FULLY EXERTED; DAYS TO 50% FLOWERING : 76-80;
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: PROPOSED STRAINS ESCAPES MOST OF THE DISEASES AND PEST UNDER FIELD CONDITIONS BEING EARLY DURATION; BLAST AND BROWN SPOT ARE MAJOR DISEASES OF UPLANT ECOSYSTEM OF THE STATE, THE PROPOSED STRAIN HAS GIVEN LOWER SCORE AGAINST BROWN SPOT. BLAST AND SHEATH BLIGHT (NSN-2 AICRIP 1966). THE PROPOSED VARIETY HAS ALSO RECORDED THE FAVOURABLE SCORE AGAINST BACTERIAL LEAF BLIGHT UNDER NATURAL (FIELD) CONDITION COMPARED TO CHECK VARIETIES, ANNADA DN KALINGA-3
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: AMONG THE MAJOR PEST GALL MIDGE IS MAJOR PROBLEM IN CHHATTISGARH STATE, THE PROPOSED STRAIN DANTESHWARI, R 302-111 WAS PROVED RESISTANT TO GALL MIDGE WHEREAS CHECK VARIETIES, POORNIMA, ANNADA AND KALINGA-3WERE SUSCEPTIBLE.

seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: Sr. Scientist (G&PB) and head, AICRP- Rice, Agricultural Research Station, Gangavati-583227, University of agricultural Sciences, Raichur
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Suitable for normal, early and late sates of planting in irrigated ecology
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features:
a.	Agronomic features 
-	Sowing dates-July-August during Kharif and November-December during summer.
- Spacing-20 X 15 cm.
-	Fertilizer responsiveness-200:100:100 kg NPK/ha.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics:
- Complete panicle exertion above flag leaf
- Light green colour of leaf as compared to other varieties
- Strong culm
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Strong culm, light green leaves, medium tall, intermediate panicle type with 6-8 cm exertion above flag leaf, droopy panicle axis, light brown husk, medium slender grains
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Tolerant to Sheath blight, BLB & Neck blast than BPT-5204 during Kharif and tolerant to Sheath blight and Brown spot during summer than JGL-1798 in field conditions
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Tolerant to BPH than BPT-5204 during Kharif and tolerant to BPH during summer than JGL-1798 in field conditions
seednet_fields.Average Yield (Kg/Ha): Commercial product: 70-78q,  Seed(In seed production plot):60-65q Kg/Ha

seednet_fields.Parentage: RP 2421/VL Dhan 221 Pedigree: The material from F2 onwards was handled by pedigree method at RWRC, Malan. Unifrom line MLN 2013-B-1-1-2-1-1-1 in F9 generation was entered in station trials in 2009. From 2011 to 2013 the variety was tested in the All India Coordinated Trials.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Low & mid hills under upland conditions of Himachal Pradesh.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Good, suitable for upland conditions, The yield of the proposed variety increased with increasing dose of nitrogen application from 30 kg N/ha to 90 kg N/ha. In the same trial, the variety resulted in 10.2% higher grain yield than the best check i.e., Sukardhan 1.In another trial, to determine the performanceof this variety under varying fertility levels, the highest yield was recommended fertilizers (60:30:30) and it was significantly higher than yield recorded with the application of 75% of recommended fertilizers. seednet_fields.Institution Responsible for developing B: Regional Agricultural Research Station, Polasa, Jagtial, PJTSAU -505529.
seednet_fields.Parentage: MTU1010 X NLR 34449 X MTU 1010. MTU 1010 is a short duration variety with long slender grain type having tolerance to BPH and susceptibility to gall midge. NLR 34449 is a short duration variety with medium slender grain, dwarf in nature having resistance to blast and susceptibility to BPH.
seednet_fields.Maturity (in days): Seed to flowering: 90-95 days in Kharif, 105 to 110 days during Rabi. Seed to seed: 120-125 days (Kharif) 135-140 days Rabi.
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Due to semi dwarf in height and strong culm it is tolerant to lodging and resists shattering. Suitable for sowing from 1st June to July end. It has good yield potential under different nitrogen levels.
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Enclosed morphological description including DUS  Erect, semi dwarf plant type, long bold and slightly awned grains at the tip with good panicle exertion and medium tillering habit.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Stress: Resistant to cold at seeding stage.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: Tolerant to blast and brown spot.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Tolerant to BPH and gallmidge biotypes 1,3 and 5
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Basal: 15 kg N-20 kg P2O5-8 kg K2O. 1st top dressing at 20-25 DAT: 15 kg N. 2nd top dressing at panicle initiation stage: 15 kg N-8 kg K2O. During rabi season 50% additional nitrogen over recommended

seednet_fields.Parentage: PMS 305/PR 590 Female parent PMS 305 is developed by MAHYCO at kallakal R&D Centre, Hyderabad and PR 590 is a purified selection in Savitri Sub 1, source maintained by the company at kallkal R&D Centre.
seednet_fields.Adaptation and recommended ecology: Irrigated and transplanted State of Odisha, West Bengal & Bihar in Eastern Zone (Zone III) and Maharashtra in Western Zone (Zone VI).
seednet_fields.Agronomic Features: Non lodging, high fertilizer responsiveness and suitable for timely sown condition with the seed rate of 15 Kg/ha. The hybrid MEPH 126 has shown positive yield advantage over the National Variety check, Swarna in 8 location out of 9 locations tested for fertilizer responsiveness viz., Aduthurai, Chinsura, Chilima, Karjat, mandya, Nagina, Rajendranagar and Maruteru; 7 out of 9 locations tested over Zonal checks viz.,  Aduthurai, Chinsura, Chilima, Karjat, mandya, Nagina, Rajendranagar and Maruteru; 7 out of 8 locations tested over Zonal checks viz., Aduthurai, Chinsura, Chilima, Karjat, mandya, Nagina, Rajendranagar and Maruteru.
seednet_fields.Specific Morphological Characteristics: (i)Semi erect flag leaf (ii)White anther.	(i)Semi erect flag leaf (ii) Yellow anther	(i)Semi erect flag leaf (ii)Yellow  anther
seednet_fields.General Morphological Characteristics: Semi erect plant type, semi erect medium long flag leaf with semi tall stature, strong culm, and long panicles with MS/MB grains.
seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Diseases: The hybrid is Moderately Resistant to Leaf Blast, Neck Blast and Bacterial Leaf Blight.
seednet_fields.Fertiliser Dosage (Kg/Ha): Urea: 35-40 kg SSP: 125-150 kg MOP: 20 kg ZnSo4: 10 kg (In Zinc deficient plots). The whole fertilizer has to be applied as basal before the final puddling of the main field.

seednet_fields.Reaction to Major Pests: Less damage due to Gall midge biotype 1, biotype 5, less number of stem borer white ear heads, less damage to Leaf folder and whorl maggot damage compared to hybrid check KRH-2
